thread:
Priya (AE): Hey team — ACME Legal just signed the LOI, asking us to run a 3-week technical POC. Need alignment on scope, success criteria, and integration checklist. Can SEs + security weigh in?
Sam (SE): Congrats! Quick Qs: will they use our hosted API or want a dedicated pool / VPC? That affects auth and quotas.
Priya (AE): Initial ask is hosted but they want the option to move to Dedicated if throughput needs it. For now assume hosted + potential Dedicated follow-up.
Maya (Security): I have the security questionnaire. Key items: data residency, KMS integration, retention period, and encryption in transit/at rest. I can drop answers but need confirmation on telemetry payloads.
Carlos (Eng): For the integration checklist: SDK usage (python/node samples), OAuth API keys, streaming vs non-streaming guidance, retry semantics, rate limit headers, and example backoff. I'll prepare snippets.
Sam (SE): For SDK: show streaming example + fallback to polling. Example curl/token flows and the node SDK streaming callback. Also include headers they need to watch: x-rw-limit, x-rw-remaining, x-rw-reset.
Sam (SE): Proposed retry policy: idempotent requests -> immediate retries up to 2, streaming interruptions -> resume with continuation token if available, otherwise restart with client-side dedupe key.
Carlos (Eng): Rate guidance: for POC target we'll support 50 req/s steady per-org on hosted default quota. If ACME needs >200 req/s we recommend Dedicated or a quota request. Also outline burst behavior.
Jordan (SRE): Observability ask: we'll give them per-route latency & token cost dashboards. Need them to add a 5-min canary and a traffic steer to fallback model for degradations. I'll provision a temporary trace span for their team.
Maya (Security): Data handling: confirm we can set retention to 7 days for POC, and we can toggle telemetry off if they want. KMS: we support their AWS KMS via cross-account key policy? Need their security engineer to sign the CLA.
Priya (AE): Success criteria suggested by customer and us: 1) functional integration (SDK auth + streaming) 2) latency: p95 < 350ms for 1k token avg requests 3) quality: eval prompt set pass rate >= 85% on acceptance prompts 4) stability: <1% error rate over 48h load test 5) cost within agreed demo budget. Agree?
Sam (SE): Agree with wording. I'll add concrete eval prompt set (20 prompts) and share a script to run locally against staging.
Carlos (Eng): I'll add an example Node snippet for streaming + retry and a recommended quantization/model variant to hit the cost/latency target.
Jordan (SRE): I'll run a capacity smoke test Wed 10am PT and post results. If p95 spikes we'll enable small-batch caching for prefixes.
Maya (Security): I'll return the partially filled security questionnaire by EOD tomorrow and add the KMS integration steps.
DeployBot: staging-poc-acme environment created: rw-stage-acme-191987. Credentials sent to Priya via vault.
Priya (AE): Nice. Action items: Sam -> SDK + eval prompts; Carlos -> code snippets + quotas doc; Maya -> sec Q by EOD; Jordan -> smoke test Wed. I'll draft POC timeline for ACME and share with them today.
Sam (SE): Ping me if you want a live walkthrough for their engineers during onboarding. Happy to join. :thumbsup:
Priya (AE): Thanks everyone — I'll loop in ACME SRE/Eng and book the kickoff for Monday.
